title: A change to how a benchmark run is counted or priced lands with one small real probe run whose stream is kept
goal: An item whose touches change how bench_* or agent_bench count or price a run carries, before its landing, one capped real probe per shape it changes (a fresh run, a resumed session question, a web arm) with the stream kept, and its list cost within 20% of the billed cost; planted fake streams alone do not prove it. SP-2vhfsn4o: fake-runner tests passed while real runs showed five billing-shape defects (kb-arm web searches and the inner Haiku call, session running totals, 1-hour cache writes, the Sonnet 5.5 read price, a default-priced arm), found only by three smoke records costing 96 USD
